name: Long Table
description: Single-ink editorial system in the register of a supper-club poster or Risograph zine. Warm rust terracotta ink (#B53D2A) on buttery cream paper (#FAF1E2). Bricolage Grotesque 800 uppercase display, Fraunces italic-default body. Outlined cards, pill buttons, edition badges. Signature 4px radial-dot paper texture overlay.
